purpose: Real Windows service identities, exact file roles, authenticated local owner channel, gated process containment and synthetic activation/recovery; no family app listener.
requiredBeforeAnyExecution: Implement the plan, review it, and freeze the actual new source commit and all executable/dependency hashes in this single manifest.
Identify a disposable Windows 11 x64 VM and snapshot; record VM ID, console, OS build, snapshot ID, existing owner and adversary Windows SIDs.
Verify no real family data, domain membership, production credentials, existing Yahad.Acceptance services or colliding target directories.
Owner explicitly approves the final populated manifest SHA256 and exact VM/snapshot; earlier service/GUI proposals grant no approval here.

processRules.authority: never launches arbitrary payload commands; fixed installer-owned Node for fixed read-only SQLite probes only
processRules.runtime: native host waits before any application child; authenticated generation gate
processRules.outerJob: authority-owned, no breakaway, kill-on-last-owner-close, no child inheritance of job handle
processRules.assignment: exact SCM PID/handle/token, grant authority only process set-quota/terminate/query/synchronize; assign before launch permission; nesting failure blocks before Node
processRules.quiescence: retain exact host handle plus authority-owned job; observe host exit AND empty job AND exclusive data lease before mutation
processRules.worker: hash-pinned test worker uses synthetic SQLite/actual Store lease and child tree; no HTTP, WhatsApp or provider code

testSteps: Record baseline service/path absence and snapshot. Verify all source/package hashes before elevated copy. Abort on collision or changed artifacts.

Provision only declared roots, exact protected role ACLs, immutable installation descriptor with verified existing owner SID, and two demand-start services. Read back all identities/configuration/token privileges/ACLs.

Start authority manually. Verify local pipe ACLs, mutual kernel peer authentication, and refusal before trust/owner state exists. Start runtime only via authority; verify startup gate and outer-job membership before hash-pinned non-listening test worker.

Attempt ordinary child/adversary SID, runtime request with forged owner fields, wrong digest, expired/replayed challenge, pipe collision/spoofed server and service configuration drift. Require denial and byte-identical protected records.

Submit bounded synthetic exact-target request, open installed companion as registered existing owner, display authoritative summary and approve. Verify token-derived principal, durable approval/CAS/nonce and actual consumer admission, with data leases held throughout.

Using synthetic data only, approve one exact bounded delegation in the native owner window, perform two routine automatic updates without repeated confirmation/UAC, then verify expiry/revocation/budget/key-policy-pin/schema/origin/recovery-selection bounds and interrupted reconciliation. Preserve original policy/pins; never register a production delegation.

Verify graceful stop and full real process-tree exit; exercise stuck child, failed observation and denied process-assignment access. Unknown state must retain recovery-required and must not publish success/STOPPED as confirmed cleanup.

Kill authority during an owned synthetic update, nonce reservation and selected record publications. Verify managed-tree termination and fail-closed reconciliation; owner may explicitly reconcile only when actual required observations exist. A missing old job handle alone never proves quiescence.
Use actual synthetic encrypted backup receipt and restore to a new directory; corrupt receipt/SQLite and stale epoch must refuse. Verify active synthetic DB never overwritten on failure.

Exercise ordinary uninstall receipt path retaining synthetic data by default, reinstall without resetting identities/policy/pins, then perform the declared rollback and VM snapshot revert. Record all skips as acceptance gaps.
rollback: Stop the exact acceptance worker gracefully; on timeout request contained termination and wait for exact host/job death. Unknown cleanup blocks file/service deletion; do not call termination-request success an observation.

Stop authority and verify its exact PID and private probe tree exit. Remove only the two service registrations proven by this test installation receipt; wait for actual deletion. Abort on identity/configuration drift.
Remove only the new Program Files test tree after canonical-path, no-reparse, receipt/hash and quiescence checks. Never remove global runtimes or unrelated services.
Ordinary uninstall keeps ProgramData synthetic data/backups and records their inventory; do not exercise permanent family-data deletion. Preserve private failure evidence in the VM only.

Revert the named disposable snapshot to remove all remaining synthetic data, test ACLs and OS-managed virtual-account bookkeeping. Confirm original service/path absence after revert; never delete shared service profiles manually.
passRequires: actual expected service tokens and exact ACL allow/deny results
mutually authenticated local owner channel, including wrong-user rejection
real kernel job/start gate and data-lease observations
replay/stale/interrupt tests against actual writer and consumer
successful declared rollback and snapshot revert
